The income statement has no 'Operating income' line. It goes from Total selling and administrative expense to Interest (income) expense, net, Other (income) expense, net, and Income before income taxes. The report gives EBIT of 3,850 as a non-GAAP measure (Item 7, p. 32; Note 15, p. 87). EBIT is net income plus net interest and tax, so it includes other (income) expense, net. It is not the published operating income line, so it was not used.

not_in_report.question: The company's current share price today
not_in_report.answer: The report gives no current share price. It gives only the aggregate market value of shares held by non-affiliates at November 28, 2025 (about $80.5 billion) and the average buyback price of $67.63 per share in fiscal 2026. Neither is a current price.
not_in_report.source: Cover page; Item 7, Liquidity and Capital Resources, p. 46

not_in_report.question: The company's own earnings guidance for the next fiscal year
not_in_report.answer: No quantitative guidance for fiscal 2027 appears. The report says only that negative impacts from Greater China and Converse are expected to continue throughout fiscal 2027, and that its product, marketplace and brand actions should be complete by the end of December 2026.

not_in_report.question: An analyst's estimate of the company's fair value
not_in_report.answer: The report contains no fair value estimate of the company. Item 1A states that NIKE does not confirm analysts' projections.
not_in_report.source: Item 1A, Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements and Analyst Reports, p. 9

limits: Operating income is not published, so operating_income and operating_margin are not_applicable. The analyst may want to consider the non-GAAP EBIT of 3,850 (8.3% margin), but it is not the requested line.

Page numbers were taken from the report's page markers and the Item 15 index. Some extracted text has garbled characters, for example in the Greater China table and Notes 1, 12 and 13. The figures used were checked against the clean statements.
Fiscal 2026 results include a 986 benefit in cost of sales from expected IEEPA tariff recoveries and 385 of severance charges (Item 7, p. 31). Both affect comparability.
Total financial debt uses book value net of swap fair-value adjustments (7,942). Face value is 8,000.
Global Brand Divisions and Corporate are presented in the segment note as reconciling or non-reportable items and are not counted as reportable segments. The count of 5 follows the report's wording.
The CFO is due to leave on August 17, 2026 (Item 1, executive officers footnote, p. 8). This is not a financial figure but may be relevant to the analyst.
